output.answer:
Based on Tesla's official Q3 2024 earnings report (released October 23, 2024), here are the key figures:

**Q3 2024 Deliveries:**
- **462,890 vehicles** delivered
- Production totaled 469,796 units (443,668 Model 3/Y and 26,128 other models including Cybertruck, Semi, Model S/X)
- This was a record third-quarter volume and marked Tesla's first quarter of delivery growth that year (up 6.4% QoQ)

**Q3 2024 Net Income:**
- **$2.2 billion** (GAAP)
- **Up 17%** year-over-year

The strong results were lifted in part by higher regulatory credit sales and the strength of Tesla's energy business, though automotive gross margins improved to 20.3% as well. Tesla also noted that its cost of goods sold per vehicle reached its lowest level ever at approximately $35,100.

Sources: [Tesla Q3 2024 Update](https://ir.tesla.com/_flysystem/s3/sec/000162828024043432/tsla-20241023-gen.pdf), [WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/business/autos/tesla-earnings-q3-tsla-6e84b457), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/tesla-stock-soars-for-best-day-since-2013-as-investors-cheer-q3-earnings-report-223811898.html)
